name: pl018
note: Project cell library for automatic place and route (design D4). Only restoring cells: every output is driven by an inverter or a static gate, so the synthesis tool may connect cells freely; the unbuffered pass-gate cells (xor_tg8, mux_tg6, fa_tga20) stay in the full-custom slice, where their drivers are known. 'cell' names the netlist in step3_cells/cellnet.py, k the width scale, r the P/N ratio. Sizes marked provisional are replaced by the minimum-PDP sizes of the corrected Step 3b sweep.

BUF.name: pl_buf
BUF.note: output buffer, X1 and X2 stages, not swept
